channel.title: Moon Watch
channel.description: Expected lunar impact-flash rates per window and scope. Computed by AI build threads (v1: Claude Opus 5.5; v1.1 data verification: Claude Sonnet 5.5; Anthropic) for Jonathan Carroll's ResearchJobs project; the model, data and gate are in the repository. Not reviewed by a lunar-impact specialist. Expected rates are model estimates, not observations.
